rollout.note: the base CPG gait, no randomisation, so the sample repeats

stability.note: 0.004 is the project's own timestep. 10 rad of joint travel is far outside any commanded range (the CPG commands under 1 rad) and well below the thousands a runaway reaches, so it separates the two without being tuned to either.
